{{Top}}
[[File:Corellian_Corvette_Hologram.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A CR90 corvette hologram displayed on a holotable]]
A '''holotable''' was an entertainment and communication device. The table featured a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] used to play virtual games, watch broadcasts, display information, or to establish communication with others beings.

The [[Death Star conference room/Legends|Death Star conference room]] included a large [[Imperial holotable]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>
